title: Birch Bark

intro: Broth is a Food item in The Long Dark. It is made using a Cooking Pot and a fire, and can rarely be found as loot. It is capable of providing the Warming Up benefit when cooked or reheated by a fire. Broth can be rarely found as loot inside of containers or as a loose item in domestic environments: such as inside the houses of Milton, Thomson's Crossing, or Coastal Townsite.

title: Tin of Coffee

fields.name: Tin of Coffee
fields.examine: A tin of ground coffee. Who knows how long it's been sitting here? A drink that can take the edge off fatigue, and warm your insides on a cold night.

intro: A Tin of Coffee is a drink which can be brewed into a Cup of Coffee at a Fire with potable water. Consuming the cup of coffee will restore 10% of the survivor's Fatigue, add some hydration and 100 calories, and provide the Fatigue Reduced benefit, making this item very useful when exploring regions with lots of Rope Climbing or when trying to Escape the Darkwalker.

intro: A Wolf Quarter is a section harvested from a Wolf or Timberwolf. A Poisoned Wolf will not allow a Wolf Quarter to be harvested, as they have no meat on their bodies.
